stock.description: B & S International Holdings Ltd. operates as an investment holding company with a core focus on the distribution and retail of food and beverage products across Hong Kong. The company's diverse distribution inventory includes confectionery like sweets and candies, baked items such as biscuits, cakes, and pastries, in addition to instant beverages, dried meats, various teas, pasta, fresh eggs, and condiments. These products are supplied to an extensive clientele, ranging from major supermarkets, pharmacies, and convenience stores to department stores, bakeries, specialized confectionery shops, and trading enterprises. Furthermore, the firm manages a network of retail outlets featuring a variety of international food and beverage brands and also provides catering services. As of March 31, 2022, B & S International Holdings Ltd. maintained 62 company-owned retail locations. Founded in 1990, its corporate headquarters are situated in Yau Tong, Hong Kong.
